import Mathlib

example {α β γ : Type} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) : Function.Injective (g ∘ f) := by
  intro a b h
  apply hf
  apply hg
  exact h

⊢ a = b
